Should NOT reason about identity conflation, split points, posthumous mentions or clustered warnings in its own prose — that doctrine belongs to check-warnings.

Should create the complete tree from the read -- Thomas, Bridget, John, Kate, the Couple relationship with its Marriage fact, all four ParentChild relationships, and both source descriptions all reach tree.gedcomx.json with quality: 1 refs.

Bridget Doyle's Death (1875) and Residence (1880) facts must both be carried through with their standard_date/standard_place sidecars exactly as the fixture returned them -- init-project must not 'fix' or drop either fact because check-warnings flagged them as inconsistent.
